thread:
Ava (CEO): Morning — quick weekly from me. Three short asks and a metrics snapshot. Will keep it tight. @everyone :wave:

Diego (VP Product): Thanks Ava — reading. Will share with PMs after this thread.

Ava (CEO): 1) Launch readiness: our EU Private beta goes live to the first 10 customers on Monday. Ops/Platform, confirm runbook + rollback are signed off. If not, call it out now.

Maya (Head of Ops): Runbook is live in Confluence: https://redwood/dc/runbooks/eu-private-beta. Canary steps + abort criteria listed. We still need one more on-call in the Friday rotas for 8–12 UTC.

Sam (Analytics): I'm seeing a baseline latency improvement on the canary regions — p50 down ~12% after the kernel tweak. Pulling a short gif for the dashboard.

Ava (CEO): 2) Policy change (short): updated data retention defaults for hosted accounts. New default: 90 days for request logs, 365 days for billing/usage metrics. This is effective next Tuesday. Legal & Security already signed. Put a banner on the Console and add a self-serve opt-out flow.

Diego (VP Product): Noted. I'll add the banner copy and link to the opt-out flow. PMs: loop in support docs.

Maya (Head of Ops): Ops note: retention change requires a migration job for existing orgs that elected the longer retention. We're scheduling the job Sat AM; will notify customers with >30d retention.

Ava (CEO): 3) Metrics and focus areas this week: keep model-serving SLOs stable while we ramp Dedicated capacity. Key numbers — please review and flag if anything unexpected:```
- Platform p99 inference latency: 420ms (target 400ms)
- Hosted cost per 1k tokens: $0.98 (goal 0.85)
- Dedicated capacity utilization: 72% (safe band 60–85%)
- Query success rate: 99.87% (SLA target 99.9%)
```

Sam (Analytics): I'll publish the short-form dashboard link: https://analytics/redwood/weekly/latency-cost — baseline and cohorts. Will call out any outliers by EOD.

Ava (CEO): Tactical asks (owners):
- Maya: confirm Saturday migration schedule + customer comms (owner: Maya)
- Diego: Console banner + opt-out flow (owner: Diego)
- Sam: pin p99 and cost charts to exec dashboard and send a short note if p99 stays >410ms for +2 hours (owner: Sam)

Diego (VP Product): We'll also add a temporary circuit-breaker: if p99 >500ms for 30m, route new traffic to fallback smaller model family. Ops/Runtime: please make sure the fallback policy is active.

Maya (Head of Ops): Acknowledged. Runtime team confirmed fallback policy is deployed to prod canaries. OpsBot: scheduled migration job for 2026-03-28 06:00 UTC.

OpsBot: Reminder set — migration_job_eu_private_beta at 2026-03-28T06:00:00Z.

Ava (CEO): Two closing notes: first, celebrate the team for the kernel optimization work — looks like measurable wins. Second, if anyone sees customer-facing anomalies during the rollout, escalate to incident channel and ping me.

Diego (VP Product): Thanks — will shout out the runtime team in the all-hands.

Sam (Analytics): Sending the short gif and the p99 trend now.

Ava (CEO): OK, that's it. Short, tactical week. If you need clarity, DM or drop in my calendar block. :rocket:

Maya (Head of Ops): Copy — prepping comms.

Diego (VP Product): Closing loop — PMs informed.

Ava (CEO): End of thread.
